chosen.premise: Despite its thin body, Bellsprout spits corrosive fluid from its mouth that melts even iron.
chosen.hook: This skinny flower can melt iron with its mouth.
chosen.visualIdea: Contrast Bellsprout’s thin silhouette with its mouth dissolving a solid iron block.
chosen.note: The contrast between a delicate, 0.7-meter, 4-kilogram body and fluid that melts iron is instantly striking and fully supported by the Pokédex.

candidates.premise: Bellsprout roots itself to replenish water, but becomes unable to escape an enemy while rooted.
candidates.hook: Bellsprout’s feet keep it alive—and trap it in place.
candidates.visualIdea: Show roots drinking underground water, then an enemy approaching as Bellsprout struggles to move.
candidates.note: A highly specific survival tradeoff: its roots provide water but make escape impossible. Strong contradiction with an easy visual sequence.

candidates.premise: If Bellsprout notices anything moving, it immediately flings a vine at it.
candidates.hook: For Bellsprout, movement triggers an instant vine attack.
candidates.visualIdea: A tiny moving speck appears, and a vine instantly snaps across the screen toward it.
candidates.note: A clear trigger-and-response mechanic that can be shown instantly, though it is less surprising than the iron-melting claim.

candidates.premise: Bellsprout’s bud resembles a human face, inspiring rumors that it is a legendary mandrake plant.
candidates.hook: Bellsprout’s face started a legendary-plant rumor.
candidates.visualIdea: Zoom into the bud’s face-like features, then reveal the rumored mandrake connection.
candidates.note: The human-face resemblance and mandrake rumor are unusually specific to Bellsprout, but the rumor may need extra context to sustain a full short.

candidates.premise: Bellsprout’s extremely skinny body hides a surprising advantage: blinding speed when catching prey.
candidates.hook: Bellsprout looks fragile—until it catches something.
candidates.visualIdea: Hold on Bellsprout’s thin body, then use a speed streak as it snatches a bug.
candidates.note: Supported and characterful, but “blindingly fast” is difficult to depict concretely and the premise lacks a stronger contradiction.

candidates.premise: Bellsprout reaches Weepinbell at level 21, but needs a Leaf Stone to become Victreebel.
candidates.hook: Bellsprout’s evolution has two completely different requirements.
candidates.visualIdea: Level counter hits 21 to become Weepinbell, then a Leaf Stone triggers the final evolution.
candidates.note: Accurate and easy to animate, but evolution requirements are a familiar Pokémon format and not especially surprising.

rounds.request: N/A—the iron-melting contrast is strong enough. A stronger alternative would need an equally specific, surprising contradiction with direct Pokédex support and a more distinctive visual payoff.
